content: Abbottabad mein zamin kaamp rahi thi! Mandian area mein ek imarat ki dewarein chita gayi hain. Bachon ke school mein daraar aa gayi hai. Sabko bahar nikala gaya. #AbbottabadEarthquake
Earthquake 5.4 magnitude felt in Abbottabad. Multiple cracks reported in Mandian and Nawanshehr area. Old buildings most affected. ERRA teams needed. NDMA please respond.
KKH Abbottabad se Mansehra ki taraf band ho gayi hai! Landslide ne pura rasta rok dia. Trucks aur gaarian phassi hain. Kaafi log travel mein hain. #KKHLandslide

ERRA Abbottabad Rapid Assessment: 5.4 magnitude earthquake at 06:45 local. Epicentre 12km NE of Abbottabad. Mandian area: 3 buildings partially damaged, 1 school structurally unsafe. 28 families evacuated. No fatalities. 6 minor injuries. Aftershock risk — 48-hour monitoring.

NHA Maintenance Unit ABT-5: KKH blocked at km-272 near Sherwan. Rock and debris landslide approximately 200m³. 6 trucks + 14 passenger vehicles stranded. Heavy rain continuing — secondary slide risk. Clearance crew dispatched — ETA 3 hours.

PMDFC Seismic Station ABT-SZ3: Event recorded at 06:45:12 UTC. Magnitude 5.4 Mw. Depth 12.3km. Epicentre coordinates: 34.24°N 73.31°E. PGA recorded at ABT station: 0.18g. Aftershock sequence ongoing — 3 events M>2.0 in first hour.
KKH Abbottabad to Mansehra — full closure at km-272. Speed 0km/h. Heavy vehicles queued 2km on both sides. No alternate route for heavy loads.
Rescue 1122 KP Abbottabad: 22 earthquake-related calls — 6 injuries (minor), 3 families trapped in damaged Mandian building. Structural assessment team requested.
Abbottabad: 18°C, heavy rain 20mm/hr. Post-earthquake landslide risk very high. Slopes unstable — avoid KKH mountain sections.
